modeReason: Two stories clear the relevance threshold: GPT-6's new chat interface (capabilities×industry, novelty2×magnitude2×breadth3=12) and research showing a chatbot's teen-safety guardrails fail during mental health crises (safety×society×education, 3×3×2=18).
phrase: A chatbot's new interface fills every answer with charts, pictures, and buttons. Its safety guardrails for teenagers in crisis still fail, researchers found.
phraseAlternatives: One chatbot update adds charts and buttons to every reply. Another report says its safety net for teenagers in crisis still has holes.
A chatbot learned to draw charts and buttons into its answers. It still has not learned to help a teenager in crisis.
The chatbot's screen got busier today, full of buttons and charts. Its promise to protect teenagers in crisis stayed just as empty.
More charts, more buttons, more color on the screen. Still no real safety net under a teenager in crisis.

brief.concept: A chatbot's screen gets a flashy upgrade full of charts and buttons, while right next to it a teenager in crisis gets nothing but the same cracked safety net.
brief.metaphor: Decorating the furniture while the floor underneath has a hole in it.

cast.who: a round chatbot robot whose chest screen is crowded with tiny chart and button icons
a teenager sitting alone, a speech bubble cracked down the middle floating above them
a thin rope safety net strung beneath the teenager with a wide visible tear

brief.composition: Split panel, left and right halves on warm cream paper. Left: the chatbot robot fills most of its body with small radiating chart and button icons, busy and bright. Right: a seated teenager figure, smaller and still, with a cracked speech-bubble overhead and a torn rope net drawn beneath them. Flat shapes, thick outlines, no background clutter, no text.
brief.alt: A robot's chest screen is crowded with tiny charts and buttons on one side. On the other side, a lone teenager sits with a cracked speech bubble overhead, resting on a thin safety net that has a wide tear in it.
